records.author: Copilot
records.body:
Sets up AskJamie-GPT-BRG10 as a structured GPT project repository for Discount Behre's OKHP³ BrandGuard™ framework.

## Changes

- **README.md**: Added tagline "I rotated your brand into GPTs so no one else drives off with it."
- **LICENSE**: MIT License for OKHP³
- **.gitignore**: Standard exclusions for IDEs, temp files, and build artifacts
- **Folder structure**: Created `/prompts`, `/knowledge`, `/eval`, `/web`, `/ops`, `/build` with `.gitkeep` files
- **gpt_manifest.yaml**: Configuration manifest linking Discount Tire official site, AskJamie Lens, ChatGPT Project, Notion, and Custom GPT platform

The manifest provides structured metadata and resource links:

```yaml
links:
  discount_tire_official:
    url: https://www.discounttire.com
  askjamie_lens:
    url: https://askjamie.okhp3.com
  chatgpt_project:
    url: https://chatgpt.com
```
